name: Cross-solver consistency gate (three-dimension mutual adjudication)

interface.input: arm records (solver family, quantities, surface profiles, energy ledger, provenance) + one JSON configuration
interface.output: digest-stamped JSON report with a solver x quantity difference matrix, per-dimension verdicts and an investigation list

failure_modes: fewer than two comparable arms -> withheld, never 'consistent'
arms with different case_id or duplicate ids are rejected, not averaged
a dimension that exceeds the acceptable band returns inconsistent and queues an investigation instead of being rounded into a pass
